title: Thermodynamically Consistent Machine Learning for Fracture Prediction in Heterogeneous Materials
abstract: arXiv:2610.20614v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding fracture behavior is critical for assessing the structural integrity and longevity. Highly time-consuming physics-based fracture simulations motivate the development of machine-learning-based fracture evolution prediction with surrogate models. However, most existing machine-learning models for fracture prediction operate as black boxes and require large training datasets to generalize reliably. In this work, Thermodynamically Consistent Latent Dynamics Identification (tLaSDI) for parametric systems is introduced to predict fracture patterns and evolution in heterogeneous materials. The model learns the thermodynamic state variable in a lower-dimensional latent space using parametric GENERIC Formalism-Informed Neural Networks (pGFINNs) that enforce key thermodynamic principles, such as total energy conservation and entropy generation. translated_title: 用于非均质材料断裂预测的热力学一致性机器学习
translated_abstract: 理解断裂行为对于评估结构的完整性和使用寿命至关重要。基于物理的断裂模拟极其耗时，这促使人们开发基于机器学习的代理模型来预测断裂演化。然而，大多数现有的断裂预测机器学习模型以黑箱方式运行，并且需要大量训练数据才能实现可靠泛化。在这项工作中，我们引入了面向参数化系统的热力学一致性潜空间动力学辨识方法，用于预测非均质材料中的断裂模式及其演化。该模型使用参数化GENERIC形式体系信息神经网络（pGFINNs）在低维潜空间中学习热力学状态变量，该神经网络强制执行关键的热力学原理，例如总能量守恒和熵产生。该模型通过硬约束方式将物理嵌入到神经网络架构中……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了热力学一致性潜空间动力学辨识框架，利用强制满足总能量守恒和熵产生等热力学原理的参数化GENERIC形式信息神经网络，在低维潜空间中高效预测非均质材料的断裂模式与演化过程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Thermodynamically Consistent Latent Dynamics Identification (tLaSDI), which uses parametric GENERIC Formalism-Informed Neural Networks enforcing energy conservation and entropy generation to efficiently predict fracture patterns and evolution in heterogeneous materials from a low-dimensional latent space.
